subject: Follow-up: context-length & token-volume details for pricing
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acme.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: context-length & token-volume details for pricing

Hi Alex — great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery and a few follow-ups so we can get a pricing/POC recommendation over to you: 

Key takeaways from call:
- Primary use case: RAG + multi-turn assistants for customer support and contract summarization.
- Current traffic shape: mostly steady weekdays with bursts during product launches.
- Integration: API-first (server side) with preference for a committed capacity + usage overage model.

To confirm pricing inputs, could you share ballpark answers to the items below? If you don't have exact numbers, ranges are fine — we can calibrate later.

Requested stats for pricing:
1) Avg prompt tokens per request (typical queries before generation)
2) Avg completion tokens per request (typical generated output)
3) % of calls that need extended context windows: 8k, 32k, 128k (approx %)
4) Expected daily/monthly request volume or estimated monthly token consumption
5) Target budget range (monthly) and any target $/1M tokens you'd like to hit

Why we ask: your answers will let us size a committed package and recommend whether 8k/32k/128k contexts or quantized model variants are the right fit for unit economics. We can also run a quick tokenization/profile pass on a small sample of prompts to validate the averages.

Next steps: if you can reply with the items above, I'll loop in Nikhil (solutions eng) to propose a POC plan and a pricing model (committed vs pure usage). If helpful, we can also schedule a 30-min follow-up to walk through the profiling results.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acme.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Follow-up: context-length & token-volume details for pricing

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and the clear asks. Answers below (these are estimates from our engineering lead; happy to refine with logs):

1) Avg prompt tokens: ~480 tokens (user query + retrieval context on average)
2) Avg completion tokens: ~960 tokens (summaries + follow-ups)
3) Context window needs: ~70% of calls fit within 8k, ~25% need 32k, ~5% may require 128k (the latter for whole-contract summarization, not daily).
4) Volume: currently ~8k inference requests/day. Rough monthly token estimate: 8,000 * (480+960) * 30 ≈ 345M tokens/month. We do have spikes during product launches — peak days could be 2–3x.
5) Budget: target monthly budget of $30k–$50k to start. We're aiming for unit economics around $40 / 1M tokens (rough target) but open to committed discounts if we can get predictable pricing.

We can share a redacted sample of 200 prompts and a couple full-contract examples for profiling. Please loop in your SE.

— Alex
Alex Chen | Head of AI Product
Acme AI
alex.chen@acme.ai | (212) 555-0199
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acme.ai>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: context-length & token-volume details for pricing

Thanks Alex — this is super helpful and exactly what we need. 

Quick notes / next steps: 
- The monthly estimate (~345M tokens) maps well to a committed tier conversation. We'll run unit-economics scenarios at your $30k–$50k target to see what per-1M rates look like under different commit sizes.
- Nikhil — can you run tokenization profiling on their sample (200 prompts + 2 full contracts) and validate the 8k/32k/128k split? Also run a projected monthly-cost model for both committed and on-demand options.
- Alex — if you can drop a redacted sample into the Drive link above or send directly to Nikhil, we'll prioritize profiling. If you prefer a quick call, I can set up a 30-min slot this week.

I'll prepare a short POC proposal (scope + success metrics + estimated pricing) once we have the profiling output.

Thanks — Marissa

1) Run tokenization and context-length profiling on the 200-sample set + the 2 full-contract examples. I'll calculate avg prompt/completion tokens and confirm the 8k/32k/128k percentages.
2) Produce a short pricing model (committed tiers and on-demand) showing the effective $/1M tokens at several commitment levels that match your $30k–$50k target.
